propositions: The module-size allowlist escape hatch (.github/module-size-allowlist.txt and .github/module-size-ceilings.txt) allows 12 grandfathered modules to persist above the 800 LOC soft cap and grow further via ceiling bumps.
Each of the 12 grandfathered modules must be split along a real call-graph seam (without creating files under 100 LOC) and removed from the allowlist and ceilings files.

The allowlist/ceilings mechanism must be completely removed, including both config files, the sync contract test, and the allowlist branch in the shell gate, while maintaining enforcement of the 800 LOC absolute cap.
A hard gate must be added to prevent the module-size limit itself (800 LOC) from being changed through normal contribution processes, requiring admin manual override instead.
